emails.subject: Fully executed contract — 123 Maple Ave, Rye
emails.body:
Hi Alex,

Congratulations — attached is the fully executed Purchase and Sale Agreement for 123 Maple Avenue, signed by both parties this afternoon. Purchase price $985,000.

Just so we're on the same page for the timeline: attorney review wraps up 7/11, the inspection contingency runs through 7/18, mortgage commitment is due 8/7, and we're targeting closing on 9/5. All of that is spelled out in the contract.

Let me know if your buyers have any questions.

Best,
Dana Cole
Harborview Realty

emails.subject: Can we see 45 Oak Street this week?
emails.body:
Hi Alex,

Sarah and I drove past 45 Oak Street in Port Chester yesterday and we'd love to get inside before it goes. Any chance you could set up a showing Thursday or Friday evening? We're flexible after 5:30.

Also — did the listing agent ever get back to you about whether the basement is included in the square footage?

Thanks!
Marcus

emails.subject: Quick questions before Saturday
emails.body:
Hi Alex! Two quick things — is the inspection still on for this Saturday? And when should we start booking movers given the closing date? Trying to line things up with work. Thanks so much!

Priya

emails.subject: Inspection report ready — 123 Maple Ave
emails.body:
Alex,

The full home inspection report for 123 Maple Avenue is attached. Overall the home is in good condition. Two items to flag for your buyers: the water heater is near end-of-life (11 years) and there is minor moisture staining in the basement that we'd recommend monitoring.

Please share with your clients before the inspection contingency deadline.

Thanks,
ProHome Inspections
